description: Variation of condition 2 (approved plans) to allow for retrospetive changes to the full height double glazed curtain walling with single height double glazed curtain walling with cladding to match existing, the removal of the approved mezzanine floor, extension of the entranceway southwards and the creation of a separate trolley bay (including the installation of metal roller shutters for the neighbouring unit of planning permission 00580/AI/P1 approved 04/06/2021 for the change of use from A1(non-food) retail to open A1 (including food) retail, subdivision of the existing unit to form two A1 retail units, car park reconfiguration, external alterations and associated works
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun no later than the expiration of three years from 01/04/2021.

Condition : 3 - The development shall be carried out in all respect in accordance with 18-02434 - Cover Letter dated 24th June 2021; 8106-BOW-ZZ-XX-RP-A-0002 - Materials Palette dated 22nd June 2021. Received: 22/06/2021, and as approved under application 00580/AI/P1(3) on 28/07/2021.

Condition : 4 - The premises shall be used for A1 (Retail) use only and for no other purposes under the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, (or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking or re-enacting that Order with or without modification) and notwithstanding the provisions of The Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (As Amended) (or any order revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification) no change of use shall take place.
Condition : 5 - No additional floorspace shall be formed within the buildings hereby permitted by means of horizontal division without prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 6 - The use hereby permitted for A1 (Retail) purposes shall not be carried out outside the following times Monday to Saturday 7am-11pm and Sunday 10am-6pm.

Condition : 7 - No demolition or construction works shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8:00am to 6:00pm on Mondays to Friday and 9:00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays, and non shall take place on Sundays or Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 8 - All Non-Road Mobile Machinery (NRMM) used during the course of the development that is within the scope of the GLA 'Control of Dust and Emissions during Construction and Demolition' SPG dated July 2014, or any successor document, shall comply with the emissions requirements therein.

Condition : 9 - The development, including all necessary mitigation measures, shall be implemented in accordance with the recommendations of 18-4753 Preliminary Ecology Report by Syntegra dated February 2019 received: 04/09/2019.

Condition : 10 - The development shall be carried out in all respect in accordance with 18-02434 - Cover Letter dated 18th February 2022. Construction Logistics Plan dated 31/03/2022. Received: 18/02/2022., and as approved under application 00580/AI/P1(10i) on 31/03/2022.

Condition : 11 - The development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with 18-02434 - Cover Letter dated 24th June 2021; 8106-BOW-A0-ZZ-DR-A-1001 Rev P1 - Soft and Hard Landscaping Plan. Received: 24/06/2021. SP-01 Rev: 01 - Typical External Works Details; LD(14)-SP-01 Rev: 02 - Site Layout Plan; LD(14)-SP-02 Rev: 01 - Parking Bay Layouts; LD(14)-SP-09 Rev: 01 - Electric Charging Point Details. Received: 28/07/2021, and as approved under application 00580/AI/P1(11) on 19/08/2021.

Condition : 12 - The parking, loading and turning spaces shown on drawing Received: 30/10/2020 and numbered SK04 Rev: BB Site Plan, shall be constructed and available for use before the first occupation of any part of the development and such spaces shall not be used for any other purposes.

Condition : 13 - The development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with 18-02434 - Cover Letter dated 26th January 2022. Received: 26/01/2022, and as approved under application 00580/AI/P1(13i) on 17/03/2022.

Condition : 14 - The development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with 18-02434 - Cover Letter dated 26th January 2022. Received: 26/01/2022. Delivery and Servicing Plan V3 dated 19/11/2021. Received: 31/03/2022, and as approved under application 00580/AI/P1(14i) on 01/04/2022.

Condition : 15 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with Bikehangar and Sheffield Stand product brochures received 26 January 2022; and drawing 8106/SK04/KK received 20 April 2022, and as approved under application 00580/AI/P1(15i) on 04/05/2022.

Condition : 16 - A. The development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with 18-02434 - Cover Letter dated 13th August 2021; Memo from Stroud Associates Ltd dated 09 August 2021 and referenced SU127. Received: 16/08/2021.
B. Within 3 months of first occupation, evidence, (e.g photographs, installation contracts and as-built certificates under the National Calculation Method) shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority to show that the development has been constructed in accordance with the approved Energy Strategy, and any subsequent approved revisions.
Condition : 17 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with 6001 Rev: B Proposed Drainage GA received on 04/09/2019.

Condition : 18 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with 18-02434 - Cover Letter dated 26th January 2022. Car Park Management Plan V5. Dated 19th November 2021 Received: 26/01/2022, and approved under application 00580/AI/P1(18i) on 23/03/2022.
